rows.heading: Cumulative Stay Cap
rows.quote_snippet: 4.1 Maximum Cumulative Career Stay: No executive shall be permitted to spend more than an aggregate of 10 (ten) years at a single city or designated Geographic Cluster over their entire career in the Corporation. 4.2 Computation of Cumulative Stay: Cumulative stay shall be computed as the mathematical sum of all historical postings (SCD2 records) served at work centres belonging to the same station or cluster, irrespective of breaks between postings or promotions in place. 4.3 Overstay Review: Corporate HR shall compile annually a list of all officers who have completed 5, 8, and 10 years of cumulative stay. Officers who have completed or exceeded 10 years at a single cluster (notably Delhi-NCR or Mumbai Urban) shall be placed on the mandatory outstation transfer proposal list for immediate redeployment to operational assets. 4.4 Retention Exceptions: Retention beyond the 10-year cumulative cap can only be granted under exceptional circumstances: (a) impending superannuation within 2 to 3 years; (b) certified severe medical conditions approved by the Special Review Board; or (c) explicit CMD approval for vital national hydrocarbon projects.

rows.heading: Short Title, Commencement and Scope
rows.quote_snippet: 1.3 The core objectives of job rotation and transfers in ONGC are: (a) ensuring optimal deployment of specialized technical and managerial talent across upstream operational theatres; (b) broadening multi-basin and operational exposure for executive leadership development; (c) ensuring equitable sharing of arduous and remote postings; and (d) maintaining operational readiness and business continuity in critical exploration, drilling, production, and refining activities.
